question: We can obtain an image that is real and of equal size when an object is placed _______ of a _______ mirror.
solution:
The correct answer is **at C, concave.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **When we place object at C of concave mirror, we get a **real and inverted image** of same size.

** **** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4559099e983c784e4cb4d771ae67e2c40ff29a36f87d2a23a41b82e5b3ffb12f.png] **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional-information:**__

 
• ** **When we place object between P and F of concave mirror

 
 
• ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a2739de132759e5e6d86011571d196ca79cac099f557d25b82842807c0b9166.png] 
 
• We get an image which is** virtual , erect and larger** than the object.
 
 
 
• When object is placed focus of concave mirror.
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f54cde7608d43a3e72c6344534d1ddf1c7a5bf5390b6ffb48bcce5ece33f63ce.png] 
 
• image formed will be** highly enlarged , erect and at infinity.**
 
 
 
• **​**When object is at focus of convex mirror:
 
 
• We cannot place any object at focus of convex mirror as it will be inside the mirror.
 
 

 

 

8a
